description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

What You'll Do

- Support ongoing litigations and arbitrations and enforcement procedures in the UK, Ireland, MENA and offshore jurisdictions.
- Provide support to other European jurisdictions, through external counsels if necessary.
- Manage response to contentious inquiries, including managing pre-litigious and regulatory matters, encountered by the company and internal stakeholders.
- Dealing with cross-border data requests
- Manage pre litigation claims.
- Drafting and reviewing court, arbitration documents, liaison and settlement agreements.
- Partner with cross-functional and regional teams and provide support on legal matters of varying complexity, sensitivity, and tangibility.
- Manage billing, legal contracts and other legal administrative documentation.
- General overall support to the compliance l team.

What We're Looking For

- A law degree (LLB, or GDL/PGDL) or an equivalent paralegal qualification. Progress towards the SQE or another legal qualification is a plus.
- 2 years or more of paralegal or legal assistant experience, ideally in disputes, litigation or regulatory work at a law firm or in-house team.
- Exposure to the financial, banking or crypto sector is a must.
- Experience with handling regulatory inquiries, requests for information and investigations is a plus.
- Interest in the cryptocurrency industry and its development.
- Proactive and self starter. Able to handle stress, have higher tolerance to dynamism and can move fast.
- Ability to work independently and report matters efficiently.
- Excellent drafting skills.
- Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

Why Binance

- Shape the future of finance
- Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
- Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
- Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
- Competitive salary and company benefits
- Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)
